lane: Cross-cutting: share surfaces (server allow-list, app numerology_map and new daily_sky share card) and the public share landing page redesign in apps/web (Owner approved 28/11/2026: Step A of docs/proposals/SHARE_LANDING_REVIEW_2026-11-24.vi.md plus the server part of Step B)
goal: Fix the numerology_map share path end to end (app drops the server event, server rejects the surface, website drops the utm surface and shows tarot copy), add numerology_map and daily_sky to the share-events allow-list with Deno tests, add a Daily Sky share card in the app, and rebuild the public /share landing as one frame with variants (card, reading, numbers, sky) that each give the visitor something first (card image and question, a browser-only card draw, a browser-only life-path number, today's sky line), then one phase-aware CTA, a short trust strip, per-variant OG text and a share_landing_try event.
successCriteria: share-events accepts numerology_map and daily_sky; Deno tests cover both and still reject unknown surfaces; the app list equals the server list (existing jest check).
No SQL constraint restricts share surfaces (usage_events.metadata is free jsonb), so no migration is needed; if one were needed it is written but not applied.
Daily Sky screen has a share button; the card shows only the public sky of the day (Moon sign, phase, the day's line) and never the user's chart, Sun sign, birth data or name; tests prove it.
Share links carry no name, birth date or personal number; the daily_sky link carries only public sky values (Moon sign, decan, phase id, sky date).
Each share variant has its own static route with its own OG title and description; old /share?utm_campaign=... links still show the right variant through the browser script.

Tarot variant shows the shared card art (small webp thumbnails under 30 KB each from the repo's own Moon Garden deck), keywords and one reflective question, and a 'Rút lá của bạn' draw that runs only in the browser.

Numbers variant computes the life-path number in the browser with the app's pure calc module and shows one Owner-approved block (numerology-blocks.json 2026-11-25-approved1); the date is never sent, put in a URL or in analytics.
One primary CTA per page: the waitlist ('Đăng ký thử bản Android') now, switched to a Google Play button by one config value once a Play URL exists.
Trust strip: computed on your device, reflection not prediction, 18+, links to Privacy and Safety; no fake counts, testimonials, countdowns or predictive claims.
Analytics keeps share_link_opened, waitlist_cta_click, signup_from_share and adds share_landing_try with the variant only.
apps/web build passes; share landing node tests pass; mobile tsc and jest pass; validate:data, validate:backend, validate:brand, feature preflight CI pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No SQL applied, no Edge Function deployed, no secret read or set, no Supabase/Vercel/Cloudflare/EAS/Play setting changed; no supabase command against the remote project.
PLAN.md is updated by the main session in this same branch (28/11).
astrology-daily-sky.json: only the review header changes (Owner approved the content on 28/11); no text is edited.
Not touched (another session): ProfileHome.tsx, NumerologyScreen.tsx, WhoAmI files, astrology-topic-placements.json, zodiac guides, synastry data.
No per-card OG images (Step B), no A/B title test.
Waitlist function and its stored utm fields are unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: App: new share button at the end of Bầu trời hôm nay (Khám phá → Chiêm tinh → Bầu trời hôm nay) opens the existing share sheet. Web: /{vi,en}/share/{card,reading,numbers,sky} new static pages; /{vi,en}/share keeps working for links already sent.
impact.dataWrite: None on device beyond existing local usage events. Server: usage_events rows with feature 'share' may now carry surface numerology_map or daily_sky once the function is redeployed (Owner step).
impact.backendContract: share-events allow-list gains two enumerated surfaces; request shape unchanged. Needs an Owner-approved redeploy of share-events; until then the app keeps sending them and the deployed function answers 400, which the app ignores (fire-and-forget).
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin change; Admin share metrics, if any, read metadata.surface as text and will simply see new values.
impact.privacySafety: Daily sky card and link carry only public sky values; numerology link carries no number or name; the web life-path tool and card draw run in the browser and send nothing; analytics carries the variant only.
impact.observability: Web: share_landing_try (variant) added between share_link_opened and waitlist_cta_click. Server: share_tapped/share_completed for numerology_map and daily_sky after deploy.
impact.rollback: Revert the commits; old /share links keep working because /share stays. Server change is additive.

managerTestPath: Trên điện thoại: Khám phá → Chiêm tinh → Bầu trời hôm nay → cuối trang bấm 'Chia sẻ bầu trời hôm nay' → xem thẻ không có tên hay ngày sinh. Mở link vừa tạo trên điện thoại: thấy dòng bầu trời của ngày đó và nút đăng ký. Mở /vi/share/numbers: nhập ngày sinh → thấy số chủ đạo và một đoạn ngắn, có dòng 'ngày sinh không được gửi đi'. Mở /vi/share/card?c=major-17-star: thấy hình lá, từ khóa, câu hỏi, nút 'Rút lá của bạn'.
